difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian algebraic space X, a quasi-coherent ideal I, a coherent module G and a object (F_n) of the coherent formal category Coh(X, I), a map alpha : (F_n) -> G-hat whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of I arises uniquely (up to unique isomorphism) as the completion a-hat of a genuine module map a : F -> G with I-power-torsion kernel and cokernel, together with an isomorphism beta of (F_n) with F-hat — the existence-plus-uniqueness package of the formal functions machine in its torsion-tolerant easy case. The retained proof is written: uniqueness and descent for objects of Coh(X, I) and Coh(O_X) hold etale locally on spaces (the two comparison facts of the chapter's formal-categories section), so the claim is local in the etale topology on X; on an etale scheme chart the statement is exactly the schemes existence theorem Cohomology of Schemes, lemma existence-easy, quoted by name. Retained author proof at lines 9819-9825.
